originalTitle: Show HN: JevBench, a reproducible benchmark for typed decision models
content: Hi HN! I built JevBench because Jev kicks ass, and the world deserves to know how the serious open source and fake lookalike projects really perform in comparison. Jev-class models return bounded choices and probabilities instead of text, and are disruptively faster and cheaper than LLMs, while being similarly intelligent on the text input they operate on. JevBench allows looking at accuracy, latency and price all at once, in a weighted way - you can even configure the weighting. A full run asks 534 English decisions. The v1.3 score combines chance-corrected Intelligence, Calibration, Speed and Cost. Leaderboard right now: #1 - Jev 74.4 #2 - SemIf 73.1 #3 - djev 73.0 #4 - Winnow-12B Q8 71.2 #5 reflex 4B 70.3. MIT harness, public items, frozen artifacts, scoring code and public per-task outcomes: https://github.com/fstandhartinger/jevbench Two no-signup demos: https://who-is-right.app.mintapis.com https://is-it-ai-slop.app.mintapis.com Limitations: English-only; latency from one German server; local/demo latency gets a disclosed ×2 adjustment (+150 ms on my servers) which is an informed assumption; held-out prompts still reach evaluated services; ~1-point gaps can be noise. Wdyt?
chineseTitle: Show HN：JevBench，类型化决策模型的可重复基准
chineseContent: 嗨，HN！我构建 JevBench 是因为 Jev 很出色，全世界都应该知道严肃的开源项目和假冒的相似项目相比之下到底表现如何。 Jev 级模型返回有界选择和概率而不是文本，并且比 LLM 更快、更便宜，同时在其操作的文本输入上具有类似的智能性。 JevBench 允许以加权方式同时查看准确性、延迟和价格 - 您甚至可以配置权重。完整运行需要 534 个英语决策。 v1.3 分数结合了机会校正的智力、校准、速度和成本。现在排行榜：#1 - Jev 74.4 #2 - SemIf 73.1 #3 - djev 73.0 #4 - Winnow-12B Q8 71.2 #5 reflex 4B 70.3。 MIT 工具、公共项目、冻结工件、评分代码和每个任务的公共结果：https://github.com/fstandhartinger/jevbench 两个无需注册的演示：https://who-is-right.app.mintapis.com https://is-it-ai-slop.app.mintapis.com 限制：仅提供英语；一台德国服务器的延迟；本地/演示延迟得到公开的 ×2 调整（在我的服务器上 +150 毫秒），这是一个明智的假设；保留的提示仍会到达评估的服务； ~1 点的差距可能是噪音。啥？
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
